keyFindings.description: A refused GitHub delivery is still lost on a clustered 2.10 stream. The seq-0 record stays on the leader for the 72 h window, so every redelivery fails with ErrNotStored until an operator steps the leader down, and Dispatch's sweep gives up after about 30 minutes. Required, per the INFRA-14 architect relaying INFRA-493's architect: after ErrNotStored, publish once more without the Nats-Msg-Id, in publishJetStream and the async window (async.go:207). Prove on the 2.10.29 cluster that a refused GitHub delivery is stored once room exists, with no step-down. Name in the PR where each consumer of the stream drops a repeat by event id, because an in-flight duplicate now stores a second copy. Update the docs that send an operator to the step-down.
